name: ming-image-0.1-design-layer
description: Ming-Image-0.1-Design-Layer is a 6.15B-parameter layer decomposition model from inclusionAI. It can split a flattened design image into a specified number of standalone RGBA PNG layers based on a layer plan. The layers can be recombined to reconstruct the original design, making the model well suited for graphic asset decomposition, transparent-layer extraction, and downstream editing and reuse.
zhDescription: Ming-Image-0.1-Design-Layer 可将扁平化的平面设计转化为 2 至 9 个独立可编辑的 RGBA 图层，适用于海报、演示文稿、UI/UX 布局、信息图表及其他设计素材。它通过语义指令分离文本、卡片、主体与背景，重建被遮挡的区域，并保持清晰的 Alpha 边界和重组后的视觉保真度。生成的图层可在 PSD、PPT 和 Figma 等工作流中独立移动、重新着色、替换并重复使用。
